description:
Search the organization's skills, its playbooks for how it does things, kept on Valet. Call this with words from the request when the user mentions Valet, asks how the organization does something, or names a skill your client does not have: "use the duck skill" may mean one of these. Then read each skill whose description applies with get_skill.

Matches the words of query against each skill's name and description and returns the best matches, at most five, with the sentence saying when each applies. An empty answer means no skill matched those words, not that the organization has none: list_skills names them all. Each match gives the skill's name, description, source, and version. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to search. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

query.description: Required. Words from the task or the skill's name, such as "quarterly close" or "duck".

name: find_skill
title: Find an organization skill
